approved_statement_attribution.source_linked_statements: Markdown and text exports include transcript version, segment ID, character interval and SHA-256 of the exact quoted span; JSON and FHIR retain structured origin and evidence references.
approved_statement_attribution.clinician_entered_statements: Exports visibly label each statement as a clinician-entered addition that is not audio-derived.
approved_statement_attribution.fabricated_or_missing_attribution: Export rendering rejects unsupported origins, missing source evidence and clinician entries that claim audio evidence.
approved_statement_attribution.application_graph_gate: Approved exports validate every note statement origin and exact source link before persistence and on download.
approved_statement_attribution.review_ui: Clinician additions have a visible Clinician entered label; source-linked statements have an Evidence navigation control.

limitations: Attribution is a traceability link to transcript text, not independent confirmation that the statement is clinically true.
Clinical review and exact-version approval remain mandatory; this report does not authorize clinical release.
